description: HOLE-ACTIVE-BODY. Two 40x25x10 mm blocks as two bodies: A at x 0..40 (built first) and B at x 60..100 (merge=false, built last, so the ACTIVE body). A through Hole (diameter 10 mm) is placed at the centre of A's top (+Z) face, its face reference anchored on B's extrude as the web stamps every pick. The hole must drill A, the body that owns the picked face (the Fusion 360 / SolidWorks rule), and leave B whole. Before the fix the face was resolved against B, the active body: the coplanar tier re-anchored it on B's top face and the drill missed B (hole_off_body).
derivation: Body B: 40 x 25 x 10 = 10000 mm^3, untouched.
Area: A is the hole-through-r5-40x25x10 golden, 3300 + 50*pi (two discs of 25*pi lost, the 100*pi bore wall gained); B is 2*(40*25 + 40*10 + 25*10) = 3300. Total 6600 + 50*pi = 6757.07963267949 mm^2.
AABB: (0,0,0)-(100,25,10), the union of the two block envelopes (the hole is interior to A).
Topology: A has 7 faces / 15 edges (6 planar + the bore cylinder; 12 + 2 circles + 1 seam), B 6 faces / 12 edges; 13 faces, 27 edges, 2 shells.
Mesh (linear_deflection 0.1): A meshes as the hole-through-r5-40x25x10 golden (530 vertices / 520 triangles), B as a plain box (6 faces x 4 = 24 vertices, 6 x 2 = 12 triangles): 554 / 532.

Independently cross-checked against a direct build123d construction (Box - Cylinder, plus Box) in tests/test_hole_owner_body.py::test_goldens_match_an_independent_build123d_construction: volume, area, centroid, AABB, topology and mesh counts.
tolerance_rationale: Pure boolean cut of a right cylinder from a box, plus an untouched box; GProp integrates the analytic quadric exactly (the same 1e-9 as the hole-through-r5-40x25x10 golden).
